question: On low-lying ground in six flood-prone US places, how close are Mapbox's DEM heights to USGS's 1 m lidar-derived DEM?

facts.fact: Every place kept at least 90 points off buildings with a height from USGS's 1 m DEM
In every place at least 90% of points off buildings read within 0.5 m of USGS as read
In every place at least 90% read within 0.5 m once the place's median difference is removed
In every place, points on buildings read within 0.5 m of the rest by median difference
